research_question: Do idiosyncratic 30-minute price shocks created with unusually high price impact per unit quote volume reverse after a separately completed reclaim strongly enough to trade back toward the event midpoint after twenty basis points of costs?

sources: crypto liquidity-shock and temporary price-pressure studies
reused: absolute return per quote-notional as a liquidity/impact proxy
temporary price pressure is more plausible when a shock is idiosyncratic and volume delivery is weak
direction is reversed only after an independently completed reclaim

scenario.context: a completed 30-minute move whose absolute prior-only return z-score and Amihud impact z-score are both extreme while quote volume is below its prior median
scenario.state: the focal market is the unique largest cross-sectional residual shock and no more than two markets share the event direction
scenario.confirmation: the next completed 15-minute bar moves opposite the event, reclaims at least twenty percent of the event body, closes directionally within its range and has opposite taker pressure
scenario.invalidation: beyond the event extreme plus ten percent of prior 30-minute ATR
scenario.management: target or stop first; otherwise exit after four hours
scenario.arbitration: one global open position; choose the largest fixed impact-residual quality

data.source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily five-minute klines
data.visibility: impact and residual state use only completed 30-minute bars and prior-only statistics; entry follows a separately completed 15-minute reclaim

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only the unchanged liquidity-vacuum reclaim passing every declared split advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune impact, volume, residual, reclaim, stop or target thresholds after evaluation.
